name: 86 Chaos 16.0.8 Desktop Schedule Time and Pay-Period Hours Fix
label: 16.0.8 Desktop Schedule Time and Pay-Period Hours Fix
notes: Improves desktop Schedule Builder cell width and time-chip readability without changing the mobile layout rules.
Shows partial-day request-off time ranges more clearly on desktop schedule cells.
Calculates Scheduled Hours Tracker weeks as whole pay-period weeks, including prior-month days that belong to Week 1.
